name: @dialoo/mobile
description: Dialoo Android / iOS shell (Capacitor). The UI itself lives in ../web.

scripts.android:sync: node scripts/build-web.mjs production && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync:dev: node scripts/build-web.mjs androiddev && cap sync android && node scripts/cap-dev.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: node scripts/build-web.mjs production && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync:dev: node scripts/build-web.mjs iosdev && cap sync ios
